g.text: Class Diagram - BCK09 Stock Information Management
+toAdjustmentResult(stock: StockInformation, direction: StockAdjustmentDirection, units: int, productName: string): StockAdjustmentResultDTO
+startTracking(id: StockId, productId: ProductId, initialUnits: int, startedAt: DateTime): StockInformation
Generated when stock tracking starts from a PostgreSQL sequence
and formatted as STOCK-00001. A new tracking period receives a
new StockId; UUIDs remain persistence-only identifiers.
Stock tracking is enabled by creating a StockInformation
period with startedAt and no endedAt. Stopping tracking
records endedAt; the final quantity and all prior periods
are preserved. Product has no isStockControlled flag.
Changes lock Product before StockInformation; disabling
preserves the final quantity, including non-zero balances.
A regular decrease to zero leaves tracking and Product
At order confirmation, inactive Products are rejected.
If an active Product has no StockInformation with endedAt
empty, it is not stock-tracked and no stock is consumed.
A period is current exactly when endedAt is null.
verifies Product exists / reads active state
